Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of data privacy laws and secure data‑handling practices.
  • Experience reviewing contracts from a security and compliance perspective.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Educar é um ato de responsabilidade moral e social. Junte-se a nós nesta jornada transformadora!

Em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV, que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira - a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação - junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

CONHEÇA NOSSA HISTÓRIA

A Rede de Ensino APOGEU foi fundada no ano 2000, por três jovens empreendedores e ex-alunos do Instituto Tecnológico da Aeronáutica (ITA).

Ao longo do tempo, a instituição vem realizando, com êxito, o seu propósito: já são mais de 4.600 aprovações históricas em universidades públicas de todo o país.

E, em 2023, nasceu a APG GOV: que tem como missão transformar lives na Rede Pública Brasileira – a partir de um sonho audacioso: aplicar um modelo de gestão que apoiasse o diretor pedagógico e alavancar a inovação – junto a um compromisso profundo com o desenvolvimento individual e coletivo.

Estamos dedicados a proporcionar uma operação excepcional que prepara os alunos não apenas para sucesso acadêmico, mas também para uma vida de contribuição significativa para a sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

A Nutricionista é responsável pelo monitoramento técnico nutricional nas instituições de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Utilizar ferramentas e mecanismos de monitoramento técnico nutricional na instituição de ensino, tendo como foco a oferta diária de alimentos saudáveis, adequados e seguros, do ponto de vista higiênico sanitário, resultando em menor desperdício e atendendo às necessidades nutricionais dos escolares durante o período letivo, de forma a contribuir para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento biopsicossocial, aprendizagem, rendimento escolar e formação de práticas alimentares saudáveis;
  • Observar as normativas federais do Programa Nacional de Alimentação Escolar - PNAE, as instruções normativas vigentes do Instituto Fundepar e do Conselho Federal de Nutricionista;
  • Atender ao Descrito no ANEXO I.I Alimentação Escolar do Edital de Chamamento Público SEED/PR Nº 17/2024.

Requisitos e qualificações

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Formação acadêmica completa em Nutrição;
  • Inscrita e regularizada junto ao Conselho Regional de Nutricionistas da 8ª Região.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Planejamento de Compras e Gestão Orçamentária – Capacidade de calcular a demanda de alimentos e administrar o orçamento público ou escolar de forma eficiente;
  • Gestão de Estoque e Controle de Qualidade – Experiência no controle de insumos, monitoramento de validade dos alimentos, armazenamento adequado e redução de desperdícios;
  • Habilidade de Comunicação – Facilidade para interagir com a equipe da cozinha, gestores escolares, estudantes e responsáveis, garantindo alinhamento e efetividade na execução das ações nutricionais;
  • Compromisso com a Educação Alimentar – Atuação ativa na conscientização da comunidade escolar sobre a importância de uma alimentação saudável e equilibrada;
  • Conhecimento básico em informática – especialmente para preenchimento de relatórios e acompanhamento de sistemas de gestão.

Informações adicionais

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Sphere Labs The infrastructure moving the world's money today was built for another era: slow rails, walls between markets, and compliance layered in over time creating friction. Sphere Labs is building what comes next: modern, compliance-native infrastructure for cross-border payments and settlement, designed from the ground up to work for the businesses and regulated institutions it actually runs through. We work in active partnership with banks, licensed entities, and the regulators and jurisdictions shaping how global money moves, because the infrastructure that earns institutional trust has to be built alongside it. Backed by Coinbase, Kraken, The Chernin Group, Jump Trading, Hudson River Trading, and some of the world's largest sovereign affiliates, we're a fully remote, global team building at the moment stablecoins are crossing into mainstream finance and regulated institutions are ready for modern rails. We hire self-starters: strong communicators and systematic thinkers who can look at a blank page and build something real. If you want a meaningful role in how global money movement evolves, and the upside that comes with getting in early, we'd like to meet you.

The Role

We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead our go-to-market efforts in Brazil. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role for a proven enterprise seller who understands the Brazilian payments ecosystem inside and out—and sees where stablecoins fit into its future. You'll own the full sales cycle from identifying opportunities to closing multi-year enterprise deals. Your targets are the fintechs, banks, and payment service providers (PSPs) that are shaping Brazil's financial infrastructure. You'll sell to senior finance and payments leaders, helping them understand how stablecoin rails can reduce costs, accelerate settlement, and unlock new revenue streams. This is a building role. You'll be instrumental in defining our Brazil GTM strategy, informing product development for the region, and establishing Sphere as the trusted infrastructure partner for stablecoin payments in Latin America's largest economy.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Full Sales Cycle

    Identify, prospect, and close enterprise deals with fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates in Brazil. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with procurement, legal, compliance, treasury, and C‑suite buyers. Run discovery, demos, commercial negotiations, pilot programs, and implementation handoffs. Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

  • Build & Manage Pipeline

    Leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate qualified opportunities. Develop territory and account plans that prioritize high-value, strategic accounts. Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver accurate forecasts. Identify and manage local referral partners in the FX industry. Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, events, and content for the Brazilian market.

  • Sell Value at the Executive Level

    Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage—articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities. Build business cases and ROI models tailored to each prospect's operations. Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Heads of Treasury, Heads of Payments, and Chief Product Officers. Navigate regulatory and compliance conversations with confidence.

  • Be the Voice of Brazil

    Represent Sphere at industry events, conferences, and in media engagements across Brazil. Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, regulatory developments (BCB, CVM), and customer needs. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure our platform meets the specific requirements of Brazilian customers. Contribute to building a world-class sales playbook for the region.

What We’re Looking For

  • Must Have 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience with a consistent track record of exceeding quota selling to fintechs, banks, or PSPs.
  • Deep payments and FX experience — you understand cross-border flows, treasury operations, correspondent banking pain points, and how money moves in and out of Brazil.
  • Crypto/stablecoin experience — you've sold blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, or crypto-enabled payments products (or you've been a buyer of these solutions).
  • Existing relationships in Brazil's payments ecosystem — you have a book of business and a network of senior contacts at target accounts that you can activate from Day 1.
  • Full‑cycle enterprise selling skills — you're equally comfortable sourcing your own pipeline, running a technical demo, negotiating an MSA, and quarterbacking a pilot.
  • Native Portuguese fluency and professional English proficiency.
  • Based in Brazil , ideally São Paulo, with willingness to travel internationally.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to or working at Tier 1 Brazilian banks (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, BTG) or leading fintechs (Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago, Stone, PagSeguro).
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulatory landscape — BCB instant payments (Pix), CVM regulations, crypto licensing developments.
  • Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations.
  • Experience at a high-growth startup scaling in Brazil.
  • Spanish proficiency for broader LATAM opportunities.

The Profile

You thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You're not waiting for inbound leads—you're building your own pipeline from relationships you've cultivated over years in the market. You can credibly speak to a Head of Treasury about FX exposure and settlement risk, then pivot to explaining stablecoin rails to a Chief Product Officer exploring embedded finance. You're entrepreneurial but disciplined. You bring structure to chaos—territory plans, account maps, forecasting rigor—while staying flexible enough to adapt as we learn what works in the market. You believe stablecoins are the future of payments infrastructure, and you want to be at the forefront of that shift in Latin America's most important market.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de veículos, plantas de produção e otimização de processos de manufatura. Quando se trata de desenvolvimento automobilístico, compreendemos a mobilidade como uma abordagem integral e temos paixão pelo o que fazemos. That´s us

Acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Por isso não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, idade ou qualquer outra. Você é tudo o que importa !

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Projeto de desenvolvimento de veículo comercial (Cabine: Acabamento Interno e Externo, Painel de Instrumentos, BIW e DIW).

  1. Responsável pelo controle de peças, conjuntos e sistemas das especialidades acima, dentro de programas e seus milestones (ciclo de desenvolvimento completo):
    1. Follow-up diário quanto ao andamento das atividades junto a áreas fornecedoras de serviço a engenharia de cabine e diferentes grupos de trabalho (Engenharia / Qualidade / Manufatura / Design / Liberações).
    2. Leitura, interpretação e otimização de normas, seções e desenhos técnicos do produto.
    3. Elaborar/Interpretar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais (Lista de peças, sequencias de montagem, DFMEA, CAE, controle de liberações, controle de custos, indicadores de performance etc.).
    4. Participar de reuniões técnicas junto ao cliente e fornecedores, contribuindo com argumentações técnicas, intermediando conflitos e esclarecendo dúvidas (EDAG-Cliente-Fornecedores).
    5. Captar novas demandas, com análise crítica, avaliação de impactos e interface junto ao time de projeto.
    6. Acompanhar a performance das peças via relatórios técnicos, laboratórios, testes de campo e eventualmente fornecedores, bem como escalar itens críticos junto à coordenação e gestão do projeto.
    7. Preparar apresentações técnicas (.PPTX; .XLSX) para auxiliar o cliente na tomada de decisão.
    8. Atuar ativamente no acompanhamento de montagem de veículos protótipo em oficinas do cliente, verificando line-up de veículos, disponibilidade de peças, processos e sequência de montagem, controle de itens críticos e prioridades através de controles junto ao cliente.
  2. Controle de liberações, histórico de modificações, cronograma de projeto e planos de ação:
    1. Emitir documentos correlatos no sistema para as áreas técnicas conforme padrões do cliente.
    2. Acompanhamento junto ao time de qualidade e demais áreas envolvidas.
    3. Zelar pela disciplina, integração e cumprimento das normas do cliente e da EDAG.
    4. Agendar e acompanhar reuniões que forem necessárias para o andamento do projeto.
    5. Coletar documentos necessários para introdução no sistema do cliente com as devidas aprovações.
    6. Evitar que pequenos problemas pessoais venham se tornar grandes problemas organizacionais.
    7. Atuar ativamente junto ao cliente na preparação dos documentos de liberação de componentes e na observação e cumprimento das datas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Produção ou correlatas.
  • Experiência consolidada na indústria automobilística e veículos comerciais.
  • Desejável domínio do software CATIA e sólido conhecimento dos sistemas e metodologias Volkswagen.
  • Inglês avançado desejável.

Informações adicionais

  • Para nós, a sua saúde e a da sua família são prioridade! Oferecemos Assistência Médica com coparticipação para você e seu grupo familiar primário (filhos e cônjuge).
  • E do seu sorriso, nós também cuidamos! Assistência Odontológica para você e seus dependentes.
  • Já falamos que saúde é prioridade, certo?! Nosso Convênio Farmácia reforça este compromisso. Queremos assegurar que nossos colaboradores tenham acesso completo aos medicamentos necessários, com a facilidade de desconto em folha, no mês subsequente ao da compra dos produtos.
  • Nos preocupamos também com seu bem-estar e queremos que você se sinta saudável tanto no trabalho quanto fora dele. Oferecemos o uso do Wellhub para manter uma rotina de exercícios flexível e diversificada.
  • O seu Aniversário é um dia muito especial e queremos proporcionar a você um tempo extra para aproveitá-lo ao máximo. O Day-off de aniversário é o nosso jeito de te parabenizar e de mostrar o quanto valorizamos você!
  • A pausa para alimentação é seu direito e você precisa deste momento para cuidar de você! Para isso, oferecemos vale-refeição ou vale-alimentação (você escolhe!). Agora, se você trabalha dentro de um dos nossos clientes, terá acesso ao restaurante interno local da planta e ao vale alimentação .
  • O nosso Programa de Empréstimo Consignado oferece uma solução que atende às suas necessidades financeiras de forma responsável, ágil e descomplicada, caso você precise.
  • Entendemos e priorizamos a importância do equilíbrio entre trabalho e vida pessoal. O Convênio SESC incentiva a prática de atividades que tragam satisfação e enriquecimento pessoal. A adesão é gratuita e extensível aos seus dependentes.
  • Para a garantia da sua segurança e de sua família, temos o Seguro de Vida .
  • Para facilitar a sua mobilidade, dispomos de Vale Transporte ou Fretado (apenas para pessoas alocadas dentro dos nossos clientes). O crédito é realizado diretamente no cartão da operadora de transporte.
  • Para contribuir com seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, temos parcerias com diversas escolas de idiomas e instituições de ensino que disponibilizam descontos exclusivos aos nossos colaboradores.
  • Venha fazer parte do nosso team ;)

Job Description

Reporting to: Head – Assisted Growth Programs & Product

About Wadhwani Accelerate

Wadhwani Accelerate works with growth-oriented SMEs to helps them scale revenues, enter new markets, expand in domestic and export marketsand overcome execution bottlenecks that hyper growth companies typically face. Our model focuses on productizing growth consulting by standardizing recurring growth challenges into structured, outcome-oriented service offeringsdelivered by curated experts.

Role Overview

The Manager – Services Development will play acritical role in building and scaling the “services layer” of Wadhwani Accelerate’s Assisted Growth Programs.

The role sits at the intersection of product design, expert network development, and service delivery enablement . The individualwill help convert growth challenges faced by SMEs into clearly defined, repeatable service offerings and build a high-quality panel of domain expertswho can deliver these services across regions.

This is a builder role suited for someone who enjoys creating structure out of complexity , working closely with experts, and scaling professional services in a semi-productized model.

Key Responsibilities

1. Services & Product Development

  • Workwith the Program Head – Accelerate to translate growth archetypes (e.g., export expansion, domestic scaling, channel growth, customer segmentation) into structured service offerings.
  • Helpdefine service “modules” across key execution hurdles such as:
    • Working capital & finance
    • Sales process & capability
    • Market entry & channel strategy
    • Product readiness & positioning
    • Regulatory & compliance
  • Support the creation of a service matrix (growth archetype × execution hurdle) and clearly articulate scope, outcomes, effort, and delivery format for each service.
  • Assist in defining differentiated service bundles for Accelerate Select, Accelerate Core cohorts based on advisory hours, delivery format, and expert seniority.

2. Expert Network Building & Management

  • Identify, onboard, and manage a curated panel of regional and national experts across domains such as exports, sales growth, compliance, finance, and product strategy.
  • Build strong working relationships with experts across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh.
  • Define engagement models for experts (retainer, per-assignment, cohort-based delivery, workshops, 1:1 advisory).
  • Ensure experts are aligned to Wadhwani Accelerate’s service standards, outcomes, and delivery formats.

3. Service Enablement & Quality Assurance

  • Work with program and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment of services to ventures.
  • Help standardize service delivery through playbooks, templates, diagnostic frameworks, and checklists.
  • Monitor service quality, expert effectiveness, and venture feedback to continuously improve offerings.
  • Support pilots of new services and refine them before scaling.

4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Program, Partnerships, Impact, and Operations teams to align services with cohort needs and outcomes.
  • Provide inputs into pricing logic, effort estimation, and scalability considerations for services.
  • Support internal documentation and knowledge management for service offerings.

Candidate Profile

Education & Experience

  • MBA from a reputed institute.
  • 5–7 years of work experience in consulting, SME advisory, professional services, program management, or ecosystem-focused roles.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems into clear service offerings.
  • Experience working with or managing external experts, consultants, or partners .
  • Understanding of SME growth challenges in areas such as sales, exports, finance, or compliance.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • High execution orientation with attention to detail and follow-through.

Mindset Fit

  • Comfortable operating in a build-from-scratch, evolving environment .
  • Interested in scaling impact through systems and platforms, not just bespoke consulting.
  • Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and outcomes-driven.

Why This Role is Unique

  • Opportunity to build a first-of-its-kind productized SME growth services model in India.
  • Exposure to diverse sectors, geographies, and growth challenges.
  • Direct influence on how thousands of SMEs access high-quality growth support at scale.
  • High ownership role with strong learning and leadership visibility.

O profissional será a referência técnica para a escolha, dimensionamento, testes e validação de todos os dispositivos RFID (leitores, antenas, coletores de dados, impressoras térmicas e tags). Será responsável por garantir que o hardware suporte o alto volume operacional e cumpra os rigorosos SLAs de recebimento, armazenagem e expedição de importação e exportação.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Seleção e Especificação Técnica: Definir os modelos ideais de equipamentos junto aos fornecedores (como Zebra, Viaonda, etc.), englobando:
  • Leitores fixos industriais de 8 portas para portais de leitura.
  • Antenas de alto ganho (ex: polarização circular/linear) e cabos,
  • Coletores de dados (Mobile) com sistema operacional Android.
  • Impressoras de transferência térmica RFID UHF de alto volume (203dpi), avaliando tecnologias híbridas e "On-Metal" (ex: Linha Zebra ZT400/ZT411).
  • Homologação de Insumos (Tags): Especificar etiquetas RFID UHF padrão EPC Gen2 / ISO 18000-6C adequadas para múltiplas superfícies, desde papelão e plástico para cargas gerais, até tags especiais "On-Metal" (ex: Família Silverline) para Racks e ULDs aeronáuticos.
  • Execução de Site Survey: Conduzir o levantamento em campo no terminal para definir a localização exata dos portais, validar quantidades de antenas por zona (ex: transelevadores TE/TZ, câmaras frias e docas), e especificar barreiras mecânicas e proteção contra vazamento/interferência de radiofrequência.
  • Implantação e Configuração: Realizar a instalação lógica, ativação e testes unitários/integrados de todos os leitores e equipamentos acessórios nos portais RFID.
  • Testes e Validação: Elaborar relatórios técnicos e planos de teste (Cutover), garantindo que a comunicação entre a etiqueta e a antena ocorra na distância e velocidade exigidas pela operação.
  • Treinamento e Go-Live: Elaborar documentação técnica (manuais) das configurações, treinar usuários multiplicadores na aplicação de etiquetas e operação do hardware, e acompanhar a operação inicial assistida (Go-Live).

Requisitos e qualificações

Hard Skills

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações, Mecatrônica, Automação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência comprovada com tecnologia RFID UHF (Ultra High Frequency) e profundo conhecimento dos padrões globais.EPC Gen 2 (ISO 18000-6C)
  • Experiência prática com hardwares de prateleira (Leitores Zebra, Impinj, Coletores robustos, Impressoras de etiquetas industriais).
  • Vivência na execução de Site Survey para RF e mitigação de interferências em ambientes logísticos ou industriais complexos.
  • Conhecimento sobre física de RF, compreendendo como os sinais reagem em presença de metais, líquidos e diferentes densidades de materiais.

Soft Skills

  • Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas técnicos complexos.
  • Rigor técnico e alta atenção a detalhes em ambientes de alta criticidade operacional.
  • Organização e planejamento para condução de implantações, testes e validações de infraestrutura.
  • Comunicação técnica clara com equipes multidisciplinares (operações, tecnologia e fornecedores).
  • Capacidade de colaboração em projetos que envolvem integração entre hardware, software e processos logísticos.
  • Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade na condução de decisões técnicas e resolução de incidentes.
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambientes logísticos e industriais dinâmicos.
  • Orientação para resultado e confiabilidade operacional das soluções implantadas.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.
POSITION SUMMARY - This position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, Peru
Over the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity; and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.
Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy-based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean-climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean-climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.
Responsibilities
International Ocean Policy

  • Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green-gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean-climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.
  • Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean-climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting‑edge technology, agile thinking, and a people‑first culture.

Location and Flexibility

This role can be fully remote for candidates based in Brazil, due to team distribution and occasional in‑person opportunities. If you are based in São Paulo or Porto Alegre, you are welcome to work from one of our offices on a flexible schedule.

The Opportunity

TELUS Digital seeks a talented AI Engineer, driven to implement autonomous, intelligent, and analytical AI solutions that address complex business challenges. Your role is essential in bringing sophisticated GenAI and Software Engineering concepts and architectures into tangible, production‑ready applications, enhancing digital products through autonomy, intelligence, and real‑time adaptation.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate Generative AI models, including LLMs, with external APIs, tools, and databases using secure and efficient orchestration patterns.
  • Design, develop, and deploy AI workflows and Agentic AI solutions, enabling the seamless orchestration of intelligent agents to plan and perform tasks while leveraging autonomous and/or human‑in‑the‑loop paradigms.
  • Implement and optimize multi‑agent systems, leveraging standards and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging frameworks for agent interoperability.
  • Develop evaluation frameworks, metrics, and checkpoints for agent autonomy, performance, and safety, ensuring compliance with moderation, security, and ethical standards.
  • Ensure robust AI agent operations by applying observability, monitoring, and MLOps best practices, facilitating reliable deployment pipelines and continuous performance optimization.
  • Collaborate closely with data experts, orchestrating AI model selection, tuning, and performance validation to meet specific agent‑based application needs.
  • Communicate complex AI concepts, systems, and decisions effectively to technical and non‑technical stakeholders, promoting transparency and trust in AI delivery.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience designing and deploying AI architectures, with expertise in Generative AI, NLP, LLM integration, and software engineering.
  • Strong background in building software platforms (Python/Django, Java/Spring, TypeScript/Express, etc.) capable of API integration and orchestration.
  • Strong understanding of the trade‑offs between various generative AI models and the ability to choose the right model for specific use cases.
  • Hands‑on experience with function‑calling and tools integration into LLM models, leveraging frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Expertise in data embeddings, vector databases, and chunking strategies, understanding the trade‑off between different options, and leveraging it to optimize data ingestion and application performance.
  • Experience using CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, AWS CodeDeploy, Azure Pipelines) to streamline development and deployment workflows.
  • Hands‑on experience deploying software on leading cloud platforms and utilizing AI tools like AWS Bedrock and Azure AI Services.
  • Experience leveraging evaluation frameworks (e.g., RAGAS, OpenAI Eval) and tools (e.g., DeepEval, LangSmith, Braintrust) to assess business and performance metrics of AI solutions.
  • Understanding of performance optimization, including the use of observability platforms, event tracking, and performance validation.
  • Practical knowledge of deploying AI solutions using cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP, utilizing services such as AWS Bedrock or Azure AI Services.
  • Excellent skills in prompt and context engineering, ensuring the usage of the right techniques to meet diverse project requirements.
  • Ability to communicate complex AI solutions and concepts effectively to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Agentic AI orchestration frameworks such as Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, or others.
  • Experience with advanced Agentic AI architecture, performance optimization of machine learning models, and the integration of AI into larger software ecosystems.
  • Hands‑on experience deploying AI solutions using containers and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes to ensure scalability, reliability, and efficient resource management.
  • Experience designing and implementing large‑scale data‑intensive solutions, maintaining high throughput, low latency, and data security.

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you'll work with world‑class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino’s, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech‑driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps‑first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

  • Work-Life Harmony: Enjoy flexible hours and autonomy to balance your professional and personal life

Some Of Our Benefits

  • Life insurance
  • Monthly voucher for meals, culture, education, health and mobility
  • Child care assistance and more!

Estamos crescendo muito, por isso, temos diversas oportunidades de crescimento profissional em várias linhas de atuação. Por sermos uma empresa essencialmente técnica, as vagas na área de desenvolvimento são as em maior número.

O que você irá fazer no seu dia a dia e com o que irá trabalhar?

Você fará parte de um time colaborativo focado em alcançar grandes resultados. Nossos Engenheiros de Software têm o perfil full stack e trabalham na plataforma SYDLE ONE, utilizando tecnologias como: Java, Javascript, Elasticsearch, Angular, MongoDB, AWS, entre outras. Sempre com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento.

Se interessou pela SYDLE e pela oportunidade?

Conte com a SYDLE!

Nossas oportunidades são para pessoas talentosas, independente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, classe social ou religião. Queremos crescer juntos e acreditamos que, quanto mais diverso e autêntico for o nosso time, mais rico será o nosso dia a dia. Dessa forma, buscamos ter um olhar diferenciado e cuidadoso para essa pauta nas nossas seleções. Confira nossos benefícios!

Enfim, por que impor benefícios engessados para todos, se as pessoas têm necessidades diferentes? Calvary International Church (calvary.org.br) is a faithful English‑speaking international congregation seeking a full‑time Lead Pastor who will preach the Word of God in an expository manner, graciously shepherd the congregation, and provide godly leadership.

The Church

The church was established in 1961 by a group of members from Perdizes Baptist Church to minister to the growing number of English‑speaking families that were moving to São Paulo. Today, the congregation is made up of representatives from over 15 nations, with different socio‑economic and religious backgrounds, all gathering for the purpose of corporate worship, fellowship and being equipped to go out and share the gospel of Jesus with the world. We have a full program of worship, Sunday School, community groups, and activities for children and youth. The church has both elders and deacons. The Lead Pastor serves alongside non‑vocational elders in a manner consistent with Elder‑Led Congregationalism.

The Qualifications

The Pastor must fulfill the qualifications of the office of an Elder as outlined in 1 Timothy 3:1‑7 and Titus 1:6‑9. Previous experience in a ministry role for at least five years is highly desired. A seminary degree is preferred or, at minimum, a bachelor in Bible or ministry‑related field. He must exhibit in daily life the fruit of the Spirit as found in Galatians 5:22 and display ongoing growth in sanctification, spiritual wisdom, and the knowledge of God’s will. Be able to preach, teach, and converse fluently, comfortably, and clearly in English. description:
Senior Staff Engineer, Investments Platforms

This position is for an Senior Staff Software Engineer to join the Investments Business Unit.

The Opportunity

Investments Platforms is responsible for the core platforms that model Nubank’s investments business: custody, offer, order management, accounts, settlement and related domains. These platforms are the long‑term home for our investments capabilities and the main path to move away from legacy Invest systems that still handle a large portion of critical flows today. Your mandate is to help design, evolve and execute this environment and comply with regulatory requirements.

About Nubank's Engineering Culture

We believe in small, empowered teams, a process‑light environment and a culture of ownership, learning and collaboration. Our architecture is platform‑oriented: we build extensible, agnostic business platforms (e.g., payments, banking, investments) that can be reused across products, markets and asset classes. You will be expected to think in terms of platforms first, translating complex investment domains into clean boundaries, contracts and abstractions that product teams can safely build on.

Nubank is also on a company‑wide journey to become an AI‑first company. We expect our senior engineers to be hands‑on with AI tools in their own work, and to help define how AI is used safely and productively in engineering and in products.

What We Have To Offer

  • Own the technical direction of Investments Platforms – the systems that implement Nubank’s investments business model in software (custody, offer, orders, account, settlement and more) and power how we scale investments in Brazil and future markets.
  • Lead the migration off legacy Invest systems: design and execute strategies to move critical flows into modern Nubank platforms, while we continue operating at scale and meeting regulatory commitments.
  • Work on a disruptive investments architecture – rethinking how investments should be modeled and operated end‑to‑end, rather than just lifting and shifting existing broker or custodian patterns.
  • Drive AI usage in a high‑impact domain: help define how we use AI in investments – both in the products we ship and in how we design, build and operate platforms.
  • Collaborate across the platform ecosystem – working closely with other business and technical platforms such as Payments and Banking, and with product squads that consume Investments Platforms.
  • Global scope with hybrid flexibility: roles are based in Brazil, in a hybrid‑first model (office presence during the week plus periodic on‑site collaboration with other locations).

Core Qualifications (What We're Looking For)

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years working on large‑scale platforms or core systems in highly available, transactional environments (finance, payments, core banking, trading, etc.).
  • Proven track record building and operating business platforms that are extensible, multi‑tenant and domain‑agnostic – e.g., custody, payments, banking, risk or similar – with clear contracts for consuming teams.
  • Experience leading strategic migrations from legacy to new architectures: co‑existence patterns, strangler approaches, staged rollouts and data migration strategies that keep systems up while flows move off legacy.
  • Strong foundation in distributed systems and event‑driven architectures: domain modeling, consistency and resiliency strategies, backpressure, observability, SLIs/SLOs and incident learning loops.
  • Demonstrated platform engineering leadership at scale: defining reference architectures and RFCs, building reusable libraries and tools, setting platform SLAs, and making adoption low‑friction and high‑quality for internal customers.
  • Comfortable working as a horizontal leader across stakeholders: aligning GMs, PMs, EMs and Staff/Principals on trade‑offs between speed, risk, platform consistency and product goals.
  • Deep experience mentoring and multiplying senior engineers – raising the bar on architecture, design reviews, documentation and post‑incident retrospectives.
  • Investments expertise: hands‑on experience with investments platforms (brokerage, custody, order management, funds, fixed income, equities, settlement, risk) and understanding of the Brazilian capital markets landscape.
  • Platform background: prior work on other platforms (payments, core banking, investments) that shows you can design high‑abstraction, agnostic, extensible platforms and translate complex domains into clean boundaries and APIs.
  • AI fluency: you are already experimenting with AI in your engineering practice (design exploration, code generation/review, analysis, automation) and are excited to help Nubank push its AI‑first agenda in a pragmatic, safe way.
  • Language: Portuguese fluency is important; English is a plus rather than a hard requirement. We are open to strong IC8 candidates who can ramp up their English over time, and will trade off language in favor of outstanding technical and leadership fit where it makes sense.
  • Resilience and ownership mindset: you are energized by ambiguous, high‑stakes scenarios, keep a constructive and optimistic stance, and actively pull teams toward positive cultural change instead of getting stuck in pessimism or only in the micro level.

If you feel interested in these challenges and want to work on a highly engaged and talented team transforming how investments work in Brazil and beyond, this is the place for you!

Descrição da Empresa

Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida, fornecendo uma gama exclusiva de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores, para tornar a vida e o ambiente mais seguros, saudáveis e sustentáveis. title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience)

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. We Before Me,
Do the Right Thing, and
Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is expanding its presence across Latin America, and we're looking for a locally embedded Product Manager to drive market growth in the region. This role sits at the intersection of local market strategy and product execution — you'll identify business and product opportunities unique to LatAm, shape how we localize the trading experience, and own the end-to-end user trading journey for the region. This is not a "translate and ship" role. We need someone who deeply understands how LatAm users discover, onboard, trade, and grow — and who can turn that understanding into product decisions that move our regional metrics.

Local Market Opportunity & Strategy

  • Identify and prioritize business and product opportunities specific to Latin American markets, including regional payment rails, local trading behaviors, regulatory nuances, and competitive gaps.
  • Build and maintain a deep understanding of the LatAm crypto and fintech landscape — including key competitors, user segments, regulatory trends, and macro factors that influence trading adoption.
  • Develop go-to-market product strategies tailored to LatAm user segments (e.g., first-time crypto users, active retail traders, remittance-driven users).
  • Partner with regional BD, marketing, and operations teams to align product initiatives with local growth objectives.

User Trading Journey Ownership

  • Own and optimize the full user trading journey across APP and WEB — from discovery and onboarding (Markets, Chart analysis) through execution (Order placement, Chart trading, Position management) to post-trade review (Asset analysis, Trading journal).
  • Define and execute the product roadmap for trading experience improvements in the region, balancing global platform capabilities with local user needs.
  • Analyze user behavior, funnel data, and feedback specific to LatAm markets to identify pain points and high-impact opportunities for conversion, retention, and engagement.
  • Develop strategies to serve diverse user profiles — from advanced traders to speculative and novice traders — adapting the product to their distinct preferences and requirements.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and Marketing to translate user insights into shipped product features and iterative improvements.
  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to optimize trading interface layout and usability, ensuring a seamless and intuitive experience.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure efficient feature implementation, maintaining a balance between innovation and operational feasibility.
  • Measure the impact of product initiatives through well-defined metrics, using data-driven insights to refine strategies and deliver measurable outcomes.

What We Look For In You

  • 5+ years of product management experience with a demonstrated track record in consumer-facing product, ideally in trading, fintech, or crypto.
  • Solid understanding of manual trading workflows across mobile and web — including the needs and behaviors of different trader personas.
  • Strong ability to translate user research and local market insights into actionable product roadmaps.
  • Excellent product sense, attention to detail, and a history of shipping products that users love.
  • Strong analytical skills — comfortable working with data to prioritize, validate hypotheses, and measure outcomes.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership — able to align design, engineering, data, and commercial teams around a shared vision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex ideas clearly to diverse stakeholders.

Nice-To-Haves

  • Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese. Candidates who can engage with LatAm users and stakeholders in local languages will have a strong advantage, though this is not a strict requirement.
  • Direct experience in the Latin American market — understanding of local user behaviors, payment ecosystems, regulatory environments, and cultural nuances across the region.
  • Hands-on trading experience in FX, stocks, or crypto.
  • Familiarity with technical analysis tools and charting platforms.
  • Experience working in globally distributed teams with cross-regional collaboration.

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.

What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience)

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)

Nice to have

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem

Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

A Equitar Therapies é uma clínica de neurodesenvolvimento infantil com sede no Rio de Janeiro, dedicada ao atendimento de pessoas com deficiência ou necessidades especiais, com o objetivo de promover autonomia, qualidade de vida e socialização. Com mais de 40 anos de atuação, a empresa iniciou sua história como consultoria especializada na implementação de programas de hipoterapia em universidades e centros de saúde. title: Human Resource Intern, Reinsurance
description:
AXA XL Reinsurance Business Unit is a global business organized in three key regions, North America, Bermuda and International (Europe and Asia). With a significant presence in all of the world’s major reinsurance markets, we take pride in our relationship driven underwriting; forward thinking use of science and data, tangible climate strategies, and commitment to being there for the long haul.

The strategic focus of Human Resources is to deliver the talent agenda in a World-Class way. We do this by designing and delivering programs, initiatives, tools and processes that enable AXA XL to attract, manage, engage, develop and retain the global talent needed to deliver on our opportunity and aspiration. Further, we are continuously improving HR capabilities and processes to support the business in a highly professional, efficient and cost-effective manner.

You will report to the HR Business Partner, Reinsurance based in the United States.

What you’ll be doing

What will your essential responsibilities include?

  • Responsible to support the Global HR Business Partners (HRBPs) with the CHRO, two Senior HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and Head of Talent Management and Employee Experience with a variety of administrative and operational tasks and acting as the liaison point for the finance organization.
  • Required to complete structured tasks and analyses self-supported. Partner with the Human Resources Advisor, Reinsurance to manage processes such as headcount management, ensuring data is accurate, shared with all relevant stakeholders and actioned where appropriate on a timely basis.
  • Support Reinsurance HR team by applying analysis and first level review of data, gathering information and preparing reports as required.
  • Support Reinsurance HR team by preparing data for all annual HR processes, including Performance & Development (P&D), Year-end Compensation, Talent Reviews, succession planning and promotions.
  • Complete administrative forms and templates on behalf of HRBPs.
  • Act as point of contact with local HR Operations team where applicable.
  • Act as point of contact for managers where needed in performance of duties.
  • Be a super user of MyHR and subject matter expert for all HR systems, to understand and maintain HR records and provide fit for purpose reporting, in conjunction with Global HR Operations.
  • As part of a team of interns supporting the broader AXA XL business you will be expected to provide support and cover for absences and/or peaks in work in other areas and will benefit from the same

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • Bachelor's degree in human resource management or studying toward a degree in human resource management or related field.
  • Previous professional experience preferred
  • Excellent time management and organization skills, and ability to prioritize multiple streams of work from multiple sources without sacrificing quality.
  • Fluent English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer focus, team player and process orientated.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, that is constantly adapting to organization needs.

Who we are

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.

How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business – property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.

With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.

Learn more at axaxl.com

What we offer

Inclusion

AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential. It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.

  • Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
  • Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
  • Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
  • Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
  • Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at Inclusion & Diversity at AXA XL | AXA XL. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Total Rewards

AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.

We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.

Sustainability

At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future.

Our Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

Our Pillars:

  • Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
  • Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
  • Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
  • AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see Sustainability at AXA XL.

Descrição da vaga

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

Desde os alimentos que você come, até a água que você bebe, e os medicamentos nos quais você confia, a Eurofins trabalha com as maiores empresas do mundo para garantir que os produtos fornecidos sejam seguros, seus ingredientes autênticos e a rotulagem exata. A Eurofins acredita que é líder global em testes de produtos alimentícios, ambientais, farmacêuticos e cosméticos e em serviços de agrociência CRO. É também um dos líderes mundiais independentes de mercado em determinados serviços de testes e laboratório para genômica, farmacologia de descoberta, forense, CDMO, ciências avançadas de materiais e no apoio a estudos clínicos.

Em apenas 30 anos, a Eurofins cresceu de um laboratório em Nantes, França, para mais de 48.000 funcionários em uma rede de mais de 900 empresas independentes em mais de 50 países e operando mais de 800 laboratórios. A Eurofins oferece um portfólio de mais de 200.000 métodos analíticos para avaliar a segurança, identidade, composição, autenticidade, origem, rastreabilidade e pureza de substâncias e produtos biológicos, além de fornecer serviços inovadores de testes de diagnóstico clínico, como um dos principais players emergentes globais em teste de diagnóstico clínico especializado.

Em 2019, a Eurofins gerou receita total de EUR 4,56 bilhões e está entre as ações com melhor desempenho na Europa nos últimos 20 anos.

Descrição do emprego

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, bem como as atividades de apoio (lavagem de vidraria, preparo de soluções e padrões, segregação e descarte de resíduos), atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

Essa inscrição no Banco de Talentos é para que a empresa te considere em futuras oportunidades. Entenda mais

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Desejável experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada na função de Médico.

Informações adicionais

A.P 5.3 - Local de trabalho: Santa Cruz e adjacências

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

  • Propor novas formas de trabalho quando identificadas.

  • Guapeco: Na SKA, bem-estar é para toda a família, inclusive a que tem penas, patas ou asas. Oferecemos planos de saúde para animais de estimação, garantindo mais cuidado, proteção e qualidade de vida para quem também faz parte da sua história.

A Intertechne Consultores S.A. oferece aos estudantes de Engenharia de Controle e Automação o Programa de Estágio, com período de dois anos que proporciona experiência prática em grandes projetos. Durante o programa, o estagiário atua em diversas disciplinas — Planejamento, Coordenação, Elétrica, Instrumentação, e outras — acompanhando todas as etapas de um projeto de grande porte.

Essa vivência permite aplicar conhecimentos universitários, aprender com engenheiros experientes e desenvolver uma formação multidisciplinar. Além disso, o estágio ajuda o estudante a descobrir com quais áreas tem mais afinidade e permite que seu desempenho seja observado pela equipe da empresa, ampliando suas chances futuras no mercado de trabalho.

Acreditamos que contribuir para a implantação de obras essenciais à sobrevivência e ao bem-estar humano é um verdadeiro privilégio. Há 38 anos, iniciamos uma jornada marcada por desafios superados e conquistas memoráveis, sempre movidos pela paixão pelo universo da engenharia.

Nosso Escopo Global

Estamos presentes em mais de 15 países, com projetos nos setores de Água e Energia, Infraestrutura, Óleo e Gás, Mineração, Novas Energias, Meio Ambiente e Gerenciamento. Em cada uma dessas áreas, contamos com líderes comprometidos em entregar soluções de excelência, porque esse é o jeito Intertechne de fazer acontecer!

  • Acadêmico de Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia Eletrônica ou Engenharia Química, a partir do 6º período.

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Mais do que uma mudança de nome, a AXIA representa a evolução de uma companhia sólida, que vem se transformando para atuar com mais agilidade, inovação e foco no cliente em um setor em constante movimento. A nova marca traduz energia, conexão, história e futuro.

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gestão e Monitoramento de Chamados: monitoramento de chamados, garantindo sua correta classificação, controle de SLA e prazos de atendimento; atuando preventivamente evitando risco de estouro de SLA e realizar follow-up com consultores e usuários.
  • Interface com stakeholders: ser ponto focal entre usuários-chave, consultorias e equipe interna CCSAP; realizar comunicação periódica de status; conduzir reuniões de acompanhamento e formalizar alinhamentos e decisões.
  • Governança e Indicadores: elaborar relatórios periódicos (SLA, Backlog, Aging, Volume); analisar tendências e recorrência de incidentes (problemas), propondo melhorias no processo de atendimento e apoiar na avaliação de desempenho da consultoria.
  • Controle de Qualidade: garantir que chamados sejam atendidos conforme processos definidos e encerrados com evidência adequada, descrição clara da solução e aprovação do usuário.
  • Apoio a pequenas melhorias e mudanças: acompanhamento, formalização de ações de GO-LIVE, apoiar controle de transportes e cronogramas de implantação e comunicação pré e pós-go-live.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Bacharel em qualquer área, preferencialmente em Informática, Engenharia, Tecnologia de Processamento de Dados ou outras correlatas, com experiência mínima de 5 anos nas atribuições especificadas.
  • Conhecimento funcional básico de SAP ECC ou S/4HANA
  • Conhecimento de: SAP Solution Manager/CloudALM e ferramentas de ITSM (desejável Service Now)
  • Excel intermediário/avançado (indicadores) e PowerBI ou outra ferramenta de geração de indicadores
  • Experiência com AMS
  • Conhecer conceitos de SLA e ITIL.
  • Conhecimentos em Gerenciamento de projetos, PMBok (desejável)

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. title: Senior Director, Cyber eDiscovery and Analytics
description:
Kroll is seeking an accomplished, commercially focused Senior Director to lead its Discovery & Analytics Solutions practice across Latin America , based in São Paulo . This role serves as the head of eDiscovery for LATAM , responsible for revenue growth, P&L performance, client expansion, and operational delivery across the region.

The Senior Director will oversee a São Paulo–based team, direct complex discovery and investigation matters, and collaborate closely with regional and global stakeholders across Cyber and other Kroll service lines. This individual will also play a visible thought‑leadership role in the LATAM legal, technology, and investigations markets.

This is a replacement role , continuing the leadership and strategic direction of an established and growing practice. This role reports directly to the Global Head of Discovery & Analytics Solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Practice Leadership & P&L Ownership

  • Lead the LATAM eDiscovery practice, including strategy, operations, team management, and regional execution.
  • Own P&L responsibilities for the practice: revenue forecasting, budgeting, margin optimization, and financial performance.
  • Oversee São Paulo–based delivery team, ensuring high-quality and defensible work across collection, processing, hosting, review, and production.

Revenue Growth & Client Leadership

  • Serve as the senior client‑facing leader for eDiscovery matters across Brazil and other LATAM jurisdictions.
  • Drive new business generation, proposal development, and account expansion initiatives.
  • Deepen relationships with law firms, corporate legal teams, and multinational clients to expand market share and secure recurring engagements.

Cross-Service Line Partnership & Collaboration

  • Act as a senior regional partner to Cyber, Investigations Diligence and Compliance (IDC) and other service lines:
  • Support integrated engagements where investigations, breach response, cybersecurity, and data analytics intersect with eDiscovery.
  • Work with global Relativity, AI/automation, and technical teams on platform innovation and workflow evolution.

Operational Excellence & Technical Oversight

  • Direct matter intake, scoping, workflow design, and delivery across large, complex, multilingual datasets.
  • Serve as an escalation point for technical, legal, or cross-border issues, including LGPD, GDPR, and regulatory constraints.
  • Ensure adherence to Kroll global methodologies and implementation of new technologies (including AI‑enabled workflows).

Thought Leadership & Market Presence

  • Represent Kroll at regional conferences, industry forums, legal associations, and partner events.
  • Publish thought leadership, speak on panels, and elevate Kroll’s profile within the LATAM eDiscovery and investigations community.
  • Build relationships with ecosystem partners, technology vendors, and industry groups to strengthen market reputation.

Essential Traits & Qualifications

  • 10–15+ years of experience in eDiscovery, digital forensics, litigation support, or adjacent fields.
  • Demonstrated leadership of a practice or business unit with P&L accountability.
  • Proven ability to grow revenue, win complex engagements, and build long‑term client relationships.
  • Expertise with Relativity and enterprise‑scale review technologies; experience with AI‑assisted workflows preferred.
  • Strong understanding of LATAM data privacy and regulatory frameworks, including LGPD and cross-border transfer requirements.
  • Experience managing and developing high‑performing delivery teams.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English; Spanish strongly preferred.
  • A recognized presence in the region through thought leadership, conference participation, or professional associations.

About Kroll

Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting‑edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. Ready to build, protect, restore and maximize our clients’ value? Your journey begins with Kroll.

In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.

Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit.
